reconciliation_ruling.how_to_make_this_observable: Only an authenticated retrieval can lift this. Options, in order of least privilege: (a) the owner exports his own profile via LinkedIn's 'Get a copy of your data' and drops the archive into the repo as a first-party source; (b) the owner saves the profile to PDF from a logged-in session; (c) a LinkedIn API credential with r_liteprofile/r_basicprofile scope.
